=={{header|FreeBASIC}}==
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">Const MAX_LINE_SIZE As Integer = 127
Const MAX_CANDIDATES As Integer = 10000

Type SetBit
    arr(0 To MAX_LINE_SIZE) As Byte
    size As Integer
End Type

Type SetBitList
    bits(0 To MAX_CANDIDATES - 1) As SetBit
    cnt As Integer
End Type

Dim Shared As String rowDato(0 To MAX_LINE_SIZE)
Dim Shared As String colDato(0 To MAX_LINE_SIZE)

Dim Shared As Integer rowCnt, colCnt

Dim Shared As SetBitList rows(0 To MAX_LINE_SIZE)
Dim Shared As SetBitList cols(0 To MAX_LINE_SIZE)

Dim Shared As Boolean candidateOverflow

Function stringRepeat(Byref c As String, Byval n As Integer) As String
    Dim result As String = ""
    
    If n <= 0 Then Return result
    For i As Integer = 1 To n
        result &= c
    Next
    
    Return result
End Function

Sub SplitWords(Byref s As String, arr() As String, Byref cnt As Integer)
    Dim word As String = ""
    
    cnt = 0
    For i As Integer = 1 To Len(s)
        Dim ch As String = Mid(s, i, 1)
        
        If ch <> " " Andalso ch <> Chr(9) Then
            word &= ch
        Elseif Len(word) > 0 Then
            If cnt <= Ubound(arr) Then
                arr(cnt) = word
                cnt += 1
            End If
            
            word = ""
        End If
    Next
    
    If Len(word) > 0 Andalso cnt <= Ubound(arr) Then
        arr(cnt) = word
        cnt += 1
    End If
End Sub

Sub appendStringArray(arr() As String, Byref cnt As Integer, Byref s As String)
    If cnt > Ubound(arr) Then 
        candidateOverflow = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    arr(cnt) = s
    cnt += 1
End Sub

'Generates the possible sequences.
Sub genSequence(ones() As String, Byval onesCnt As Integer, Byval numZeros As Integer, result() As String, Byref resultCnt As Integer)
    resultCnt = 0
    
    If onesCnt = 0 Then
        Dim emptySequence As String = stringRepeat("0", numZeros)
        appendStringArray(result(), resultCnt, emptySequence)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' At a minimum, onesCnt zeros are needed:
    ' one between each block and the two ends represented by the generation scheme.
    If numZeros < onesCnt Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim maxInitialZeros As Integer = numZeros - onesCnt + 1
    If maxInitialZeros < 1 Then Exit Sub
    
    For x As Integer = 1 To maxInitialZeros
        Dim remainingOnes(0 To MAX_LINE_SIZE) As String
        Dim remainingOnesCnt As Integer = 0
        
        For i As Integer = 1 To onesCnt - 1
            remainingOnes(remainingOnesCnt) = ones(i)
            remainingOnesCnt += 1
        Next
        
        Dim tails(0 To MAX_CANDIDATES - 1) As String
        Dim tailsCnt As Integer = 0
        
        genSequence(remainingOnes(), remainingOnesCnt, numZeros - x, tails(), tailsCnt)
        
        For j As Integer = 0 To tailsCnt - 1
            If resultCnt >= MAX_CANDIDATES Then 
                candidateOverflow = True
                Exit For
            End If
            
            Dim candidate As String = stringRepeat("0", x) & ones(0) & tails(j)
            
            appendStringArray(result(), resultCnt, candidate)
        Next
    Next
End Sub

Sub getCandidates(dato() As String, Byval datoCnt As Integer, Byval lineLength As Integer, result() As SetBitList)
    For si As Integer = 0 To datoCnt - 1
        Dim clue As String = dato(si)
        Dim clueLength As Integer = Len(clue)
        
        Dim block(0 To MAX_LINE_SIZE) As String
        Dim totalOnes As Integer = 0
        
        Dim invalidClue As Boolean = False
        
        For i As Integer = 1 To clueLength           
            Dim blockLength As Integer = Asc(Mid(clue, i, 1)) - Asc("A") + 1
            If blockLength <= 0 Then
                invalidClue = True
                Exit For
            End If
            
            block(i - 1) = stringRepeat("1", blockLength)
            totalOnes += blockLength
        Next
        
        result(si).cnt = 0
        
        If invalidClue Then Continue For
        
        ' It is not possible to place the blocks if they do not fit.
        If totalOnes + clueLength - 1 > lineLength Then Continue For
        
        Dim sequences(0 To MAX_CANDIDATES - 1) As String
        Dim sequenceCnt As Integer = 0
        
        genSequence(block(), clueLength, lineLength - totalOnes + 1, sequences(), sequenceCnt)
        
        For ri As Integer = 0 To sequenceCnt - 1
            If result(si).cnt >= MAX_CANDIDATES Then 
                candidateOverflow = True
                Exit For
            End If
            
            Dim sequence As String = sequences(ri)
            
            ' The first position is the auxiliary zero.
            ' The rest actually represents the line.
            If Len(sequence) - 1 <> lineLength Then Continue For
            
            With result(si).bits(result(si).cnt)
                .size = lineLength
                
                For i As Integer = 0 To lineLength - 1
                    If Mid(sequence, i + 2, 1) = "1" Then
                        .arr(i) = 1
                    Else
                        .arr(i) = 0
                    End If
                Next
            End With
            
            result(si).cnt += 1
        Next
    Next
End Sub

Sub setBitAnd(Byref sb As SetBit, Byref other As SetBit)
    Dim n As Integer = sb.size
    If other.size < n Then n = other.size
    
    For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
        If sb.arr(i) = 1 Andalso other.arr(i) = 1 Then
            sb.arr(i) = 1
        Else
            sb.arr(i) = 0
        End If
    Next
End Sub

Sub setBitOr(Byref sb As SetBit, Byref other As SetBit)
    Dim n As Integer = sb.size
    If other.size < n Then n = other.size
    
    For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
        If sb.arr(i) = 1 Orelse other.arr(i) = 1 Then
            sb.arr(i) = 1
        Else
            sb.arr(i) = 0
        End If
    Next
End Sub

Function reduce(a() As SetBitList, Byval aCnt As Integer, b() As SetBitList, Byval bCnt As Integer) As Integer
    Dim removed As Integer = 0
    
    For i As Integer = 0 To aCnt - 1
        If a(i).cnt = 0 Then Return -1
        
        Dim commonOn As SetBit
        commonOn.size = bCnt
        
        For j As Integer = 0 To bCnt - 1
            commonOn.arr(j) = 1
        Next
        
        Dim commonOff As SetBit
        commonOff.size = bCnt
        
        For j As Integer = 0 To bCnt - 1
            commonOff.arr(j) = 0
        Next
        
        For ci As Integer = 0 To a(i).cnt - 1
            setBitAnd(commonOn, a(i).bits(ci))
            setBitOr(commonOff, a(i).bits(ci))
        Next
        
        For j As Integer = 0 To bCnt - 1
            Dim k As Integer = b(j).cnt - 1
            Do While k >= 0
                Dim mustRemove As Boolean = False
                Dim cnd As SetBit = b(j).bits(k)
                
                If commonOn.arr(j) = 1 Andalso cnd.arr(i) = 0 Then mustRemove = True
                If commonOff.arr(j) = 0 Andalso cnd.arr(i) = 1 Then mustRemove = True
                
                If mustRemove Then
                    For m As Integer = k To b(j).cnt - 2
                        b(j).bits(m) = b(j).bits(m + 1)
                    Next
                    
                    b(j).cnt -= 1
                    removed += 1
                End If
                
                k -= 1
            Loop
            
            If b(j).cnt = 0 Then Return -1
        Next
    Next
    
    Return removed
End Function

Function reduceMutual(cols() As SetBitList, Byval colCnt As Integer, rows() As SetBitList, Byval rowCnt As Integer) As Integer
    Dim removed1 As Integer = reduce(cols(), colCnt, rows(), rowCnt)
    If removed1 = -1 Then Return -1
    
    Dim removed2 As Integer = reduce(rows(), rowCnt, cols(), colCnt)
    If removed2 = -1 Then Return -1
    
    Return removed1 + removed2
End Function

Sub cleanCandidates()
    For i As Integer = 0 To MAX_LINE_SIZE
        rows(i).cnt = 0
        cols(i).cnt = 0
        
        For j As Integer = 0 To MAX_CANDIDATES - 1
            rows(i).bits(j).size = 0
            cols(i).bits(j).size = 0
        Next
    Next
End Sub

' Returns:
' 1 if all possibilities are 1
' 0 if all possibilities are 0
' -1 if it cannot yet be determined
Function cellState(Byref list As SetBitList, Byval position As Integer) As Integer
    If list.cnt = 0 Then Return -1
    
    Dim canBeOne As Boolean = False
    Dim canBeZero As Boolean = False
    
    For i As Integer = 0 To list.cnt - 1
        If list.bits(i).arr(position) = 1 Then
            canBeOne = True
        Else
            canBeZero = True
        End If
    Next
    
    If canBeOne Andalso Not canBeZero Then Return 1
    If canBeZero Andalso Not canBeOne Then Return 0
    
    Return -1
End Function

Sub printSolution()
    For r As Integer = 0 To rowCnt - 1
        For c As Integer = 0 To colCnt - 1
            Dim state As Integer = cellState(rows(r), c)
            
            If state = 1 Then
                Print "# ";
            Elseif state = 0 Then
                Print ". ";
            Else
                Print "? ";
            End If
        Next
        
        Print
    Next
    Print
End Sub

Sub newPuzzle(dato() As String)
    candidateOverflow = False
    cleanCandidates()
    
    SplitWords(dato(0), rowDato(), rowCnt)
    SplitWords(dato(1), colDato(), colCnt)
    
    If rowCnt <= 0 Orelse colCnt <= 0 Then
        Print "Empty puzzle."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If rowCnt > MAX_LINE_SIZE + 1 Orelse colCnt > MAX_LINE_SIZE + 1 Then
        Print "The puzzle exceeds the maximum size."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    getCandidates(rowDato(), rowCnt, colCnt, rows())
    If candidateOverflow Then
        Print "MAX_CANDIDATES was exceeded while generating the rows."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    getCandidates(colDato(), colCnt, rowCnt, cols())
    If candidateOverflow Then
        Print "The MAX_CANDIDATES limit was exceeded when generating the columns."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    For i As Integer = 0 To rowCnt - 1
        If rows(i).cnt = 0 Then
            Print "There are no candidates for the line "; i
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next
    
    For i As Integer = 0 To colCnt - 1
        If cols(i).cnt = 0 Then
            Print "There are no candidates for the column "; i
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next
    
    Do
        Dim changed As Integer = reduceMutual(cols(), colCnt, rows(), rowCnt)
        
        If changed = -1 Then
            Print "No solution."
            Exit Sub
        End If
        
        If changed = 0 Then Exit Do
    Loop
    
    ' Display the current status.
    ' Undetermined cells appear as '?'.
    printSolution()
End Sub

' Main program
Dim As String puzzles(0 To 3, 0 To 1)
puzzles(0, 0) = "C BA CB BB F AE F A B"
puzzles(0, 1) = "AB CA AE GA E C D C"

puzzles(1, 0) = "F CAC ACAC CN AAA AABB EBB EAA ECCC HCCC"
puzzles(1, 1) = "D D AE CD AE A DA BBB CC AAB BAA AAB DA AAB AAA BAB AAA CD BBA DA"

puzzles(2, 0) = "CA BDA ACC BD CCAC CBBAC BBBBB BAABAA ABAD AABB BBH BBBD ABBAAA CCEA AACAAB BCACC ACBH DCH ADBE ADBB DBE ECE DAA DB CC"
puzzles(2, 1) = "BC CAC CBAB BDD CDBDE BEBDF ADCDFA DCCFB DBCFC ABDBA BBF AAF BADB DBF AAAAD BDG CEF CBDB BBB FC"

puzzles(3, 0) = "E BCB BEA BH BEK AABAF ABAC BAA BFB OD JH BADCF Q Q R AN AAN EI H G"
puzzles(3, 1) = "E CB BAB AAA AAA AC BB ACC ACCA AGB AIA AJ AJ ACE AH BAF CAG DAG FAH FJ GJ ADK ABK BL CM"

For p As Integer = Lbound(puzzles, 1) To Ubound(puzzles, 1)
    Dim puzzle(0 To 1) As String
    puzzle(0) = puzzles(p, 0)
    puzzle(1) = puzzles(p, 1)
    
    candidateOverflow = False
    Print "Puzle "; p + 1
    newPuzzle(puzzle())
Next

Sleep</syntaxhighlight>
